name: browser
description: Operates a real web browser: opens pages, reads them, follows links, and reports what it found.

name: terminal
description: Runs shell commands on a sandboxed Linux machine with internet access: downloads, verifies checksums, unpacks, starts and health-checks programs.

name: writer
description: Drafts documents such as announcements, emails and notes, and saves them in the word processor on the caller's screen after the caller approves.
